description:
Ask a question. Get the answer. That's the whole app.

Nimble Answers skips the browser, the tabs, the cookie banners and the pile of blue links. You type what you want to know and the answer appears — no page to load, no result to click through, no ads in the way.

It works out what kind of question you asked and answers accordingly:

MATH, INSTANTLY AND OFFLINE
Arithmetic, powers and roots, trigonometry, logarithms — all evaluated right on your device. No network, no waiting, works on a plane.

FACTS
Populations, distances, dates, capitals, conversions, who invented what. Answered from DuckDuckGo's instant answers and Wikipedia.

DEFINITIONS
What a word means, in plain language, without a dictionary site full of pop-ups.

ANYTHING ELSE
Questions the quick sources can't handle fall through to an AI model that can.

BUILT TO STAY OUT OF THE WAY
No account. No sign-up. No API keys to paste. No subscription. No advertising. No analytics, no tracking, no profile of what you've asked. The app never learns who you are because it never asks.

Eight colour themes so it looks the way you want it to.

Your recent searches stay on your device. Your maths never leaves it.
promotionalText: Type the question, read the answer. No tabs, no cookie banners, no pile of blue links to dig through.
